new_failures.failed_witness: An oversized candidate line projection truncated before an attributable complete read.
new_failures.recovery: Read the same immutable candidate in bounded numbered windows through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure line count first and cap immutable text windows before projection.

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach expression was piped directly and raised EmptyPipeElement.
new_failures.recovery: Materialised the foreach result before piping it to JSON conversion.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement in phase wrappers.

new_failures.recovery: Read the exact current-state JSON in bounded numbered windows through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Project large authorization records by measured window rather than raw whole-file output.

new_failures.failed_witness: A full manifest display exceeded the bounded projection.
new_failures.recovery: Used scalar count projection and exact normalized-LF Git-blob replay.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Validate manifest entries computationally and display only attributable summaries.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first full final-validator display truncated.
new_failures.recovery: Read all 315 lines in three bounded numbered windows without executing the validator.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure validator line count and use bounded windows before any display.

new_failures.failed_witness: Two concurrent read-only Python probes yielded sessions whose metadata was omitted by the wrapper projection.
new_failures.recovery: Reran only the manifest and JSON-parse dependencies to bounded completion with explicit result metadata.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Preserve session identifiers whenever a concurrent command can outlive the initial yield.

new_failures.failed_witness: Two stale v676 artifact names were queried against the v679 exact tree and were absent.
new_failures.recovery: Derived the v679 artifact set from its exact Git tree and committed activation candidate.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Never carry phase-relative artifact filenames across owner or version boundaries.
